interpretation_requirements: The three ON origins shareHIP98505 and one2017visit; the six contexts observe four directions and do not create independent nights.
Own-vs-other scores are postselection descriptors. Selected windows already influenced the maximized primary score and row-contribution patterns are not extra evidence.

The159slope grid is adequate only for the primary four-row span. Exact long-gap weak recurrence can miss a between-grid/differently drifting/stationary neighbor and cannot establish directional exclusivity.
Context four-row score uses the same selected local row window in each scan, rather than maximizing over context windows. Its absence cannot exclude a burst occurring at a different local time.
